Both papers are Nagata 2021 ABCD papers on screen time and weight/eating outcomes. Multi-mapped to 24 and 302.

EurekAlert Oct 7 2024 titled 'For preteens, more screen time is tied to depression...' — topic of screen time and depression in preteens maps to paper 393 (Nagata 2024 BMC Public Health: 'Screen time and mental health: a prospective analysis of the ABCD Study'), published 2024. Note: paper 394 is a duplicate record of 393 (same DOI and title); mapping to 393 only.

Summary also explicitly states 'In July, Nagata and his colleagues discovered excessive screen time was linked to disruptive behavior disorders in 9-11 year olds' — this cross-references paper 304 (Nagata 2023 JCPP: disruptive behavior disorders) satisfying L3 for paper 304. Multi-mapped to 133 and 304.

Paper 70 (Chu 2024 Eating and Weight Disorders: screen time, problematic screen use, and eating disorder symptoms in early adolescents from ABCD) is the 2024 corpus paper on this exact topic. L3: screen time + social media + eating disorder symptoms + young adolescents + ABCD uniquely maps to paper 70.

Jun 2024 date aligns with paper 139 publication year. L3: bedtime screen use + sleep displacement + parents + early adolescents + Nagata + ABCD.
